title: Mac: auto-install no longer wipes Accessibility / Screen Recording grants
highlights: Mac: the auto-install helper (Install button in News & Updates) used to run tccutil reset on every upgrade — legacy from the 0.1.30 ad-hoc-signing era when each build shipped a new CDHash. Since 0.1.50 the app is signed with a stable cert and the Designated Requirement is cert-leaf-based, so TCC keeps its grants across upgrades. The reset was actively wiping Accessibility, Screen Recording and Local Network grants every time.
Removed the tccutil reset from the install helper. From 0.1.54 forward, upgrading via the Install button preserves all previously-granted permissions.
